label: d05-followup-analysis-and-archive
command:
import gzip,json,shutil,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path("scripts/experiments").resolve()))
from reproduce_clean_install import trajectory
from nisayon.engine.diagnostics import ordinary_checks
from nisayon.engine.first_case import PREDICATES
from nisayon.engine.io import digest,file_digest,write_json
from nisayon.engine.store import verify_execution
r=Path("artifacts/d05-confirmation-failure-diagnosis-001").resolve()
out=Path("artifacts/d05-confirmation-failure-analysis-001").resolve()
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
b=json.loads((r/"bundle.json").read_text())
runs={x["id"]:x for x in b["runs"]}
original=Path("artifacts/development-ablation-001/D05-recurrent-carry/A/confirmation/execution/bundle.json").resolve()
old=json.loads(original.read_text())
observed=[x for x in old["runs"] if x["condition_id"]=="seed-10423-prefix-10-21" and not x.get("cost_parent_run_id")]
comparisons=[]
for oldrun in observed:
 for key in ("reference","prefix-21-clean"):
  actual,expected=trajectory(runs[key]),trajectory(oldrun)
  comparisons.append({"fresh_original_run_id":oldrun["id"],"exploratory_run_id":key,"actual_trajectory_sha256":digest(actual),"original_trajectory_sha256":digest(expected),"identical_measured_trajectory":actual==expected})
measured=[]
parent_cost=nested=0.0
for run in b["runs"]:
 wall=run["costs"][0]["value"]
 if run.get("cost_parent_run_id"):
  nested+=wall
 else:
  parent_cost+=wall
  measured.append({"run_id":run["id"],"physical_steps":len(run["trace"]),"ordinary_checks":ordinary_checks(run,PREDICATES),"trajectory_sha256":digest(trajectory(run)),"wall_s_including_prefix_if_any":wall})
report={"schema":"nisayon.d05.confirmation-failure-diagnosis.v1","scope":"Post-comparison exploration on spent condition 10423; no fresh confirmation, scored incident or accepted repair","declaration_commit":"b8aa0787a3aca835bb1b1985778a18ce706ff5f2","execution_commit":b["code"]["git_head"],"bundle_sha256":file_digest(r/"bundle.json"),"original_confirmation_bundle_sha256":file_digest(original),"integrity":verify_execution(b,r),"runs":measured,"measured_trajectory_comparisons":comparisons,"known_parent_execution_wall_s":parent_cost,"nested_prefix_wall_s_not_added":nested,"scored_d05_result_unchanged":"rejected"}
write_json(out/"analysis.json",report)
archive=Path("docs/experiments/results/d05-confirmation-failure-diagnosis-001")
archive.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
files={}
for name in ["calibration-protocol.json","calibration-results.json"]:
 shutil.copyfile(r/name,archive/name);files[name]=file_digest(archive/name)
shutil.copyfile(out/"analysis.json",archive/"analysis.json");files["analysis.json"]=file_digest(archive/"analysis.json")
with gzip.GzipFile(filename=str(archive/"bundle.json.gz"),mode="wb",mtime=0) as stream:
 stream.write((r/"bundle.json").read_bytes())
files["bundle.json.gz"]=file_digest(archive/"bundle.json.gz")
command=Path(".nisayon/runs/74834a0afaf747359ced6dee20d51da5/run.json")
shutil.copyfile(command,archive/"execution-command.json")
files["execution-command.json"]=file_digest(archive/"execution-command.json")
write_json(archive/"manifest.json",{"schema":"nisayon.d05.diagnosis-archive.v1","raw_root_locator":str(r),"analysis_root_locator":str(out),"files":files,"source_bundle_sha256":file_digest(r/"bundle.json"),"scope":"Compact calibration evidence; raw traces remain at the local locator. No acceptance or fresh confirmation."})
print(json.dumps({"runs":measured,"trajectory_comparisons":comparisons,"parent_wall_s":parent_cost,"nested_prefix_wall_s_not_added":nested,"integrity":report["integrity"]},indent=2))
cost_boundary: wall time for this command; human time and external costs unmeasured
